summary.interpretation: Historical frozen AMB v6 source, retrieval-mode native exact case verdict; no answer-generation quality or human judgments. Paired n=77, 6 vs 1 discordant; exact two-sided McNemar p=0.125 (unadjusted exploratory), not statistically demonstrated superiority.

review_selection.method: All seven discordant Agent Memory-versus-Mem0 cases; then lexicographically first previously unselected case per benchmark category; then lexicographically first remaining cases until 24 total. Deliberately oversamples discordant/coverage, not representative. All 77 rows remain in entries.
